mapper.select: select target_name as name, count(1) as value, group_concat(petition_id order by petition_id) as refs from jc_petition where del_flag = '0' and target_name is not null and target_name <> '' and status <> '7' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by target_name having count(1) >= 1 order by value desc

select d.dept_id as id, d.dept_name as name, count(1) as value, group_concat(i.issue_no order by i.issue_no) as refs from jc_rectify_issue i join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.target_dept_id where i.del_flag = '0' and i.status in ('0','1','2') and i.deadline is not null and i.deadline < curdate() group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name order by value desc

select d.dept_id as id, d.dept_name as name, count(1) as value, group_concat(i.issue_no order by i.issue_no) as refs from jc_rectify_review r join jc_rectify_issue i on i.issue_id = r.issue_id join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.target_dept_id where r.review_type = '2' and r.result = '0' group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name order by value desc

select d.dept_id as id, d.dept_name as name, count(1) as value, group_concat(c.clue_no order by c.clue_no) as refs from jc_clue c join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status not in ('4','5') and c.deadline is not null and c.deadline < curdate() group by d.dept_id, d.dept_name order by value desc

select p.person_id as id, p.name as name, count(1) as value, group_concat(cd.declare_id order by cd.declare_id) as refs from jc_conflict_declare cd join jc_person p on p.person_id = cd.person_id where cd.del_flag = '0' and cd.status = '存疑' group by p.person_id, p.name order by value desc
select position_name as name, least(sum(weight), 100) as value, group_concat(factor_name order by factor_code) as refs from jc_risk_model where status = '0' group by position_name order by value desc
select max(alert_no) from jc_risk_alert where alert_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
